data.name: Dyaar
data.long_meaning: Refers to something that is close, near or intimate. It can be used to describe a loved one, a beloved place or an intimate feeling.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes closeness to Allah, and can be used to describe a deep spiritual connection or bond.

in_arabic.name: دِيار
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ديار مشتق من الجذر الدال على الأرض والوطن، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع بمعنى الأرض أو المكان. وديار هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالشعور بالانتماء والوطن.

in_urdu.name: دیار
in_urdu.long_meaning: دیار نام عربی زبان کے الجذر سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے زمین یا وطن۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں گہری اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، جہاں یہ ملک یا علاقے کے لئے محبت اور وابستگی کا احساس ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: दियार
in_hindi.meaning: दियार का अर्थ है जमीन या देश
in_hindi.long_meaning: दियार नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है जमीन या देश। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण है, जहां यह मातृभूमि के प्रति प्रेम और समर्पण की भावना को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: ديار
in_pashto.meaning: ديار د ځمکې يا هيواد معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: ديار نوم د عربي ژبې له ريښې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د ځمکې يا هيواد معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دوديز ارزښتونو په منځ کې ځای لري، چيرې چې دا د وطن او مليت د پېدروسي احساس څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Dyaar
in_english.meaning: Dyaar means land or homeland in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Dyaar originates from the Arabic root 'D-Y-R' which signifies land, country, or homeland. It is mentioned in several contexts in the Quran, emphasizing the concept of land or territory. In Islamic tradition, Dyaar symbolizes a sense of belonging and attachment to one's country or community. The name carries deep cultural and spiritual significance across various Muslim cultures.

In Sufi poetry and literature, the term "Dyaar" is often used to describe a beloved, a spiritual mentor or a place of deep spiritual significance. For many Sufis, the beloved is the ultimate reality, the formless God beyond all form, and the突出 word or phrase that sums up the meaning of existence.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the term "Dyaar" takes on a deeper, more profound meaning. It is a reminder of the intimate relationship between the believer and the divine, a relationship that goes beyond the mere rituals and formalities of worship. It is a call to remember Allah (God) as the closest entity to us, the one who is intimately present in every moment of our lives. In this sense, "Dyaar" serves as a reminder to maintain a constant awareness of the presence of Allah in our everyday lives, and to seek His love and guidance above all else.
